This faith, they claim, has always spoken metaphysically, until lately challenged by the likes of Heidegger and Marion. However, when we consider Heidegger and Marion's account, we find a completely different approach to metaphysics. For them, \u201cmetaphysics\u201d is about modern metaphysics, defined with a view towards explaining the \u201cdevastation\u201d of modern European and American society, its loss of religion, its wars, its technological and environmental decimation, and its philosophical and theological failures. This article revisits this debate and contends that until a more accurate understanding of Heidegger is achieved, no genuine debate on the nature of \u201cmetaphysics\u201d is possible.
